biped.label: Biped / economy
biped.construction: Three-section twelve-sided segment shells, low-sided joint barrels, simplified pads and cuff ribs; hidden longitudinal links, microdetails and separate bearing assemblies omitted. One vertex-color palette.
biped.static_contract: LOD2 geometry is frozen in rest_pose. Local hierarchy and interface coordinates are retained; world socket positions match articulated LOD1 at rest_pose, not its neutral bind pose. Static lookup nodes do not animate.
biped.integration: Same right-side attachment frames, bone lengths, joint names and runtime as original. Apply rest_pose before an LOD1/LOD2 swap; retain LOD1 for visible motion. Material-based visibility is unavailable on the merged palette; joint rig, wireframe and shell-bone inspection remain available on LOD1.
